caption: This shoyu ramen features an amber-brown, glossy broth with floating noodles and green onions. In a white ceramic bowl with blue and green patterns, chashu pork and nori seaweed sit beside a dark, glossy spoon on a smooth red table.

segments_info.text: The table is a smooth, solid red surface with subtle light reflections and faint texture variations.
Chashu pork slice shows translucent, tender texture with browned edges and visible fat marbling, irregularly shaped.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with blue and green geometric patterns, smooth surface, slightly raised rim.
A dark, glossy spoon with a curved bowl and textured surface, reflecting light subtly.
